pages.raw_meta: Catastrophe insurance companies are not all the same. Discover Palomar’s creative approach to affordable solutions in disaster protection.
raw_blocks: Palomar is a specialty insurance company that provides property and casualty insurance products to individuals and businesses. We leverage underwriting expertise and data-driven analytics to offer innovative solutions in five product categories: Earthquake, Casualty, Inland Marine and Property, Crop and Surety and Credit. Our underwriting and analytical expertise allow us to concentrate on certain markets that we believe are underserved and can generate attractive risk-adjusted returns.
We are a publicly traded company on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange (NASDAQ: PLMR) with a financial strength rating of “A (Excellent)” from AM Best Company (“AM Best”).
Palomar is headquartered in La Jolla, California, writing business nationwide.
We put people and partners first. We build strong relationships through transparency, trust , and respect for each other.
We adapt quickly to change. Our entrepreneurial and resilient mindset drives us to remove barriers and find creative solutions to challenges.
We are bold and inventive problem solvers . We continually collaborate and evolve to provide our partners and customers with unparalleled expertise and market-leading solutions.
We celebrate diverse perspectives. We promote inclusion and equality to create more opportunities and build a better world for our team members, company, partners, and community.
We do the right thing with strong conviction, integrity and decisive action to strengthen trust within our company and with our partners and communities.

Mac Armstrong has served as our Chief Executive Officer and a director since February 2014. Prior to founding Palomar, Mr. Armstrong served as the President of Arrowhead General Insurance Agency, which he joined in 2009, previously holding the positions of Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer. Mr. Armstrong led the sale of Arrowhead to Brown & Brown, Inc. in 2012. Mr. Armstrong’s prior experience includes Spectrum Equity Investors, a private equity investment firm where he led the insurance investing practice and Alex. Brown & Sons/ BT Alex. Brown Inc., an investment bank acquired by Deutsche Bank. Mr. Armstrong earned an A.B. from Princeton University. Mr. Armstrong is a member of the Board of Advisors of Cloverlay Investment Management LLC, a private equity investment firm.

Mr. Christianson has served as our President since April 2022 and previously served as our Chief Underwriting Officer since August 2020 and as our Chief Operating Officer since joining our company in February 2014 to September 2020. Prior to joining our company, Mr. Christianson served as a Vice President of Holborn Corporation from April 2010 to December 2013. Mr. Christianson started his career with John B. Collins Associates in Minneapolis in 2002, where he serviced both casualty and property business. Mr. Christianson earned a B.A. in Economics from St. Olaf College.

Chris Uchida joined Palomar in 2015 and serves as our Chief Financial Officer. Prior to joining our company, Mr. Uchida served as the Executive Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer at Arrowhead, which he joined in 2004. Prior to joining Arrowhead, he was a Tax Manager at PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP. Mr. Uchida earned a B.S. and M.S. from San Diego State University and is a California Certified Public Accountant.

Angela Grant joined Palomar in 2020 and serves as our Chief Legal Officer. Ms. Grant most recently served as Chief Legal & Innovation Officer at CSE Insurance Group. Previously, Ms. Grant served as the Head of Compliance & Legal at Hippo Insurance. In addition to her legal and compliance background, past leadership roles at Esurance, Kemper, and GEICO burnished her credentials in mergers and acquisitions, corporate governance, and strategy. Ms. Grant received her Juris Doctor from Texas A&M University School of Law and holds a bachelor’s degree in Business Administration from the University of North Texas. She is a member of the State Bar of Texas, State Bar of California (Registered In-House Counsel), American Bar Association, Society of Corporate Compliance and Ethics, Association of Insurance Compliance Professionals (AICP), and the National Association of Women Lawyers (NAWL).

Mr. Knutzen has served as our Chief Risk Officer since April 2019. Mr. Knutzen most recently served as a Partner at TigerRisk Partners, and previously held roles at Holborn Corporation, Guy Carpenter and John B. Collins Associates.

Mr. Beyerle has served as our Chief Underwriting Officer since April 2022 and previously served as our Senior Vice President of Inland Marine since January 2019. Before joining the company, Mr. Beyerle spent 16 years at Great American Insurance Company, most recently as a Divisional Senior Vice President in their Property & Inland Marine Division. Mr. Beyerle’s insurance experience includes three years as a commercial insurance producer at Acordia Southeast. Mr. Beyerle earned a bachelor’s degree from Florida State University and holds Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) and Associate in Reinsurance (ARe) designations.

Rudy Hervé has served as our Chief Operating Officer since June 2024. Mr. Hervé most recently served as Global Head of P&C Operations for SCOR, and previously held leadership roles at QBE North America, Bain & Company, Orange Ventures and Morgan Stanley. Mr. Hervé earned a Masters in Management from ESCP Europe and a Masters of Business Administration from the University of Pennsylvania’s Wharton School.

James Long began his role as Deputy Chief Risk Officer in 2026 after an impactful two years as our Chief Technology Officer. Mr. Long offers over 20 years of business leadership in crop insurance, risk management, data analytics, and technology. He most recently held several leadership roles over 15 years at RenaissanceRe. Mr. Long earned bachelor’s and master’s degrees in Agricultural Economics from the University of Kentucky.

Sheri Scott joined Palomar in June 2026 as our Chief Actuarial Officer. Ms. Scott most recently was a Principal & Consulting Actuary at Milliman, where she served on the firm’s Board of Directors. Prior to joining Milliman, she held leadership roles at Bank of America, AON Risk Services, Electric Insurance, Canadian Direct Insurance, and AAA Insurance. Across her 35-year career, she led the development and profitable scaling of insurance programs, consistently driving improvements in process and automation. Ms. Scott is a Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society, a Member of the American Academy of Actuaries, and a Certified Specialist in Predictive Analytics. She has a Bachelor of Science degree with a double major in Statistics as well as Administrative and Commercial Studies from the University of Western Ontario.

Tim Carter has served as our Chief People Officer since June 2024. Mr. Carter most recently served as Senior Vice President, Human Resources for LPL Financial, Inc., from August 2013 to June 2024 and previously held varied human resources leadership roles at G4S Integrated Services, Parexel, and Home Depot. Prior to his corporate roles, Mr. Carter served as a Captain in the United States Marine Corps. Mr. Carter earned a B.A. in Political Science from San Diego State University.

Kyle Morgan serves as our Chief Strategy Officer. Prior to joining Palomar in 2018, he worked as a private equity investor at Insight Partners and W Capital. Kyle earned an A.B. in Economics from Princeton University.

Jake Armstrong joined Palomar in October 2015 as VP of Strategy before shifting to the role of SVP, Underwriting, where he managed the Commercial Lines underwriting teams. Currently, he is EVP, Operations and, in that role, he manages the Operations and Product departments at the Company. Prior to joining Palomar, Jake worked at Guggenheim Partners as a Vice President, where he worked on numerous corporate development initiatives, private equity investments and asset management turnarounds. Prior to Guggenheim, he worked at Goldman Sachs in the Merchant Banking Division and Deutsche Bank in the Investment Banking Division. Jake holds an BA from Middlebury College.

David Sapia has served as our EVP Head of E&S Casualty since September 2024. Mr. Sapia offers over 30 years of extensive expertise in casualty underwriting and field management, with a specialized focus on the E&S market. Mr. Sapia most recently served as Director of Liability Underwriting for HDI Global USA and previously held leadership roles at AXIS and Guy Carpenter. Prior to his corporate roles, Mr. Sapia was a Sergeant in the United States Marine Corps and received his MBA and BS in Business Administration from the University of Denver.

Cullen S. Piske leads Palomar Surety, which was established in February 2026. Previously, he served as President of Gray Surety beginning in 2013, where he guided the company’s growth from a regional carrier into a national surety provider.
During his tenure, Gray underwent two ownership transitions, culminating in its successful acquisition by Palomar. Cullen brings more than 20 years of experience in the surety industry.

Jason Sears is our EVP, Head of Programs since August 2022. Upon joining Palomar, Mr. Sears brought with him casualty expertise and a track record in the program space. Prior to joining our company, Mr. Sears served as Executive Vice President for the MGA’s Rivington Partners and DUAL Commercial LLC, respectively. Before that he worked in management in the Programs units of two carriers, QBE and American Safety, in addition to holding underwriting, reinsurance brokerage and captive formation roles.

Benson Latham has served as our EVP, Head of Crop since October 2024. Mr. Latham most recently served as Senior VP of Strategic Accounts at Great American’s Crop division and previously held leadership roles at Crop Risk Services, Validus, Longhorn Re (founder), and ProAg. Mr. Latham earned a B.A. in Government Studies from the University of Texas at Austin.

Matt Grunewald has served as our EVP Reinsurance since October 2023. Mr. Grunewald most recently served as Head of North America for Tamesis DUAL, and previously head roles at New Paradigm Underwriters, LLC. and Greenlight Re.

Mr. Cebula joined Palomar in August 2021 and serves as Executive Vice President, Risk Management. Prior to joining Palomar, Chris spent ten years at Elementum Advisors, a dedicated Insurance Linked Securities investment manager, where he was a Principal and Portfolio Manager. During his time at Elementum, his responsibilities included primary underwriting, secondary trading, and portfolio management for the firms’ catastrophe bond-oriented accounts. Chris graduated Magna Cum Laude from Marquette University’s Applied Investment Management Program and earned his MBA from the University of Chicago’s Booth School of Business. Chris is a CFA Charterholder.

Elizabeth Seitz serves as EVP Treasury and Financial Operations of Palomar. Since its inception in 2014, she has provided GAAP and Statutory accounting and operational guidance. Prior to joining Palomar, she served as VP – Controller of Arrowhead General Insurance Agency, Inc., which she joined in 1999. Ms. Seitz was a Tax Manager at PricewaterhouseCoopers and is a California Certified Public Accountant. She earned a BA in Mathematics from Vanderbilt University and an MS in Accountancy with a specialization in Taxation from San Diego State University.

Madison Ragozin has served as our Head of AI since June 2026, leading Palomar’s enterprise AI strategy and enablement. She brings nearly 15 years of experience building, commercializing, and deploying artificial intelligence at scale. Madison has held leadership positions at Intuit, Amelia (SoundHound AI), and NICE, and began her career as a data scientist at Mattersight, where she developed machine learning and natural language processing systems for predictive behavioral routing. Madison earned a B.S. in Mathematics, with a concentration in discrete and algorithmic methods and a minor in Computer Science, from the University of Michigan.

Jeffery Lim joined Palomar in January of 2017 as our Vice President of Legal, Compliance and Claims. Currently Mr. Lim serves as Palomar’s EVP, Associate General Counsel heading the legal team and reporting to our Chief Legal Officer. Prior to joining Palomar, Mr. Lim was a managing partner at the law firm of Hager, Dowling, Lim & Slack representing insurance companies in coverage and bad faith litigation. Mr. Lim holds a Juris Doctor from the University of Oklahoma School of Law, and a bachelor’s degree in Economics from UC San Diego. He is a member of the State Bar of California.

Our Diversity, Inclusion, Community Engagement and Equality (D.I.C.E.) group leads volunteer initiatives, aligning team members involvement with community needs. D.I.C.E. champions sustainability and volunteering efforts that strengthen the communities where we live and work. Led by passionate team members, this group helps turn shared values into action by identifying meaningful opportunities, organizing initiatives, and encouraging participation across the organization.
Being a responsible and trusted partner to our customers, team members, and communities is integral to our business model and strategy.

Become an integral part of a dynamic, fast-paced team that is redefining what it means to be a leader in the insurance space. Grow alongside a company that values innovation, collaboration, and accountability.
Executive Underwriter (Casualty Excess & Surplus)
